architecture_deltas.proposed_change: Insert a synchronous zero-copy familiarity/open-set readout immediately after mtmd media encode and before llama_decode. Pool directly from the current projected embedding buffer; do not copy or persist the full projected token tensor. If KNOWN_HIGH_CONFIDENCE and task/contradiction/action-critical gates allow, emit a provenance-bound compact visual seed/PerceptualField delta and bypass full 4B semantic decode. Otherwise pass the same unchanged buffer into semantic decode. Persist only compact descriptor/prototype/evidence/version metadata unless a later experiment proves full embedding persistence necessary.
architecture_deltas.expected_benefit: Avoid duplicate heavy visual inference and avoid memory-copy/persistence cost on the shared Qwen feature path while retaining semantic decode on uncertainty or task-critical cases.
architecture_deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: A dedicated lightweight embedding encoder or learned projection produces sufficiently better calibration/open-set behavior that its added model/runtime cost is Pareto-superior; alternatively, the Qwen vision scan cost dominates so decoder bypass has little value.
architecture_deltas.resource_rule: Count sensor transport, change gate, mmproj encode, MVC gate, copies/serialization, semantic prefill/decode, EAP, RAM/VRAM, cache state and recovery cost end-to-end.
architecture_deltas.rollback: Disable zero-copy gate and route all changed visual inputs through existing semantic decode; preserve exact model/mmproj/prototype versions and last-known-good MVC state.
architecture_deltas.authority: Visual familiarity and retrieved memory remain evidence/context only; neither mints semantic truth or effect authority.

architecture_deltas.proposed_change: When a zero-copy MVC gate yields an admissible high-confidence identity, serialize only a compact PerceptualMemorySeed plus descriptor/prototype support and exact frame/model/mmproj/projection/epoch hashes into the EAP path. Never persist or treat the raw Qwen token tensor as canonical memory. Wrong/stale/ambiguous seeds remain alternatives or trigger deeper perception.
architecture_deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Any pre-decode memory seeding amplifies false familiarity/confirmation bias enough that post-decode exact retrieval is safer and equally efficient.
architecture_deltas.rollback: Disable visual-seed EAP coupling and retain EAP as general bounded ActiveAssembly preprocessor.
